stations.notes: Continuous since 2020-02-13; MUSTANG noise-psd has Dec 2021 - Feb 2022, so the UAE weekend switch (2022-01-01) can be tested. Use location 10, not 00 (sensor swap on 2022-02-02). Sharjah's local government kept a Fri-Sun weekend. LOCATION: the station service names the site "Univ. of Sharjah, Sharjah", but its coordinates (same for every sensor epoch) are ~90 km EAST of Sharjah city, in the Hajar mountains. Which emirate the sensor sits in is not verified, so the "city" here is the operator's site name, not a measured fact.
